subject: general
question: With which of the following games/sports is the William Jones Cup associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Basketball.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• William Jones Cup is named in honour of basketball promoter** Renato William Jones.**
 
• He was the Founder of the **International Basketball Federation (FIBA).**
 
• **James Naismith** is called the father of Basketball.
 
• A traditional basketball team has **12 players, **with** five basketball players on the court** at any given time.
